_readme: HoloVerse region soundtracks. Each area plays its own track, looping the whole file.
To use your own music: overwrite the placeholder file with your MP3 (keep the same name),
or point "file" at a new file in assets/audio. MP3, OGG and WAV all work.
A missing file means that area is silent; it never falls back to another area's song.
volume: 0.0 - 1.0 (on top of the Master / Music sliders in Settings).
Same-window and own-window dimensions (HoloCore, the Indigo Giant, ...) play their own
soundtracks; HoloVerse's music is silent while one is open.

hub.area: FLAT region: the MatrixCore hub and the flat land around it
